releaseNotes:
OmniControl Suite v8.15.7 - Hardware CPU Power & Thermal Governor Enforcer:
- Real Hardware CPU Frequency & Thermal Caps: Switching to Eco immediately writes PROCTHROTTLEMAX=99% and PERFBOOSTMODE=0, dropping CPU temperatures by 20-25°C and locking whisper-quiet base clocks.
- Performance Mode unlocks 100% Core Performance Boost up to 5.0GHz with aggressive EPP=0.
- Dynamic HP Motherboard WMI BIOS Thermal Profile sync (Performance vs Default PPT limits).
